adjudication.rationale: Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 5-10, the schema definition uses `[z.string().toString()]` as computed property keys, which evaluates to the literal string 'ZodString' (the toString() of a Zod schema), not a dynamic key pattern. Zod doesn't support arbitrary key matching this way. The minimumTokenResponseSchema will only match objects with literal properties named 'ZodString', not actual expiry fields like 'expires_in' or 'expiry_date'. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, this schema is used instead of the app-specific schema, and it will fail to properly capture expiry information from the OAuth response, causing the stored credentials to lack proper expiration data.
